demo.label: Interactive demo
demo.viewportLabel: Scrollable long-image demo. Use the controls below to zoom or select text.
language.label: Choose language
demo.slide1Subtitle: Less scrolling past. More looking closer.
demo.slide1Body: A long image can hold a whole story. Zoom into the details and keep reading. When a passage is worth keeping, copy the words and take them with you.
demo.slide2Subtitle: A little closer. A whole new perspective.
demo.slide2Body: From the brushwork in an illustration to the fine print in an infographic. Zoom and drag to the part that catches your eye. An image’s size should not limit your curiosity.
demo.slide3Subtitle: Good words deserve a second read.
demo.slide3Title: From an image to your notes.
demo.slide3Body: Found a passage you love? No need to switch tools or type it out again. Choose text selection in the toolbar, select the words, and save that inspiration where you need it.
demo.secondTitle: Keep the words. Skip the retyping.
demo.secondBody: Reading notes, infographics, chat screenshots. Find the part you want, select it, and take the inspiration with you.
toast.textOn: Demo text is selectable. Drag to select and copy.
toast.textOff: Text selection off. Drag to keep exploring.
toast.copyFallback: Press Ctrl+C / ⌘C to copy the selected demo text
demo.preferenceHint: These changes apply to this demo. The extension remembers your choices.
demo.guideBody: This page uses selectable example text. The extension recognizes English and Simplified Chinese locally, on request.
demo.guideStep1: Choose Start selecting to enter text mode.
demo.guideStep2: Drag to select text, then press Ctrl+C / ⌘C to copy.
demo.guideStep3: Use the copy button to copy all text in the example image.
